prompt:
Validate this DataIntersection transform against its metadata and requirements.

## Practice task (component type: JOIN)

For matched sports and entertainment events in Romania, compute spectator_limit_raised when B's spectator_limit is greater than A's, and authorization_absent when B's authorization_ref is an empty string. Set audit_escalation to the AND of these two flags. Keep every match, even when audit_escalation is false.

A metadata:
| Field | Type | Nullable |
|---|---|---|
| event_ref | long | no |
| spectator_limit | long | no |
| authorization_ref | string | no |

B metadata:
| Field | Type | Nullable |
|---|---|---|
| event_ref | long | no |
| spectator_limit | long | no |
| authorization_ref | string | no |

Matched output metadata:
| Field | Type | Nullable |
|---|---|---|
| event_ref | long | no |
| spectator_limit_raised | boolean | no |
| authorization_absent | boolean | no |
| audit_escalation | boolean | no |

Before/after event compliance registries are on input 0=A and input 1=B. Unique event_ref values are sorted ascending within each registry; Join key $event_ref=$event_ref. All three outputs are connected and carry A-only(0), intersection(1), B-only(2).

The CTL2 JOIN transformation implementing these rules, copying event_ref to each matched output record.

```ctl
//#CTL2
function integer transform() {
    boolean raised = $in.1.spectator_limit > $in.0.spectator_limit;
    boolean absent = $in.1.authorization_ref == "";
    $out.0.event_ref = $in.0.event_ref;
    $out.0.spectator_limit_raised = raised;
    $out.0.authorization_absent = absent;
    $out.1.audit_escalation = raised && absent;
    return ALL;
}
```
